name: DOTA: A Large-scale Dataset for Object Detection in Aerial Images
description: A large-scale benchmark of high-resolution aerial images with objects annotated using oriented bounding boxes, designed for object detection in aerial imagery. This record is loader-only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Xia, G.-S., Bai, X., Ding, J., Zhu, Z., Belongie, S., Luo, J., Datcu, M., Pelillo, M., & Zhang, L. (2018). DOTA: A Large-scale Dataset for Object Detection in Aerial Images. arXiv:1711.10398. https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.10398
